summary: Defines new ICMPv6 errors that a network node can send when it drops a packet because of processing limits, such as being unable to handle its headers. Without this, senders get no sign of why packets vanish. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: If a post office throws away a parcel because it is too complicated to handle, the sender never learns why. This document lets the post office send back a note giving the reason.

questions: what are the new icmpv6 errors for processing limits
